title: Games in the background ask less of your computer
lines: The town, the Works and The Little Raid now draw 20 frames a second while you are using another window, or after 2 minutes without a click, a key or a mouse move. A game left open beside Minecraft uses far less of your computer.
Moving the mouse over it, a click or a key returns it to full speed at once.

more.head: Changed
points: In the Works, the project in hand, the tier's commission and the research being studied are on a dark card with a gold edge, not on paper.
